scope: decisive trace: with count=1 the entity loop consumes the body to the end and both later blocks fail
deduction: the entity loop is entered at bit 1307 and only stops when the stream error flag is set, i.e. when it reads past length
with count=1 it consumes the remaining 24 bits as entity data and leaves the stream in the error state at bit 1375 == length*8
the playerState and actor blocks then both run on an already-errored stream (error=1), which is why state stays 9
the loop has no count-based exit: 0x471E81 returns 1 unconditionally after the error
implication: as long as count>0, our body cannot avoid the error state and state 10 is unreachable through this path
either the real count/table encoding differs from what we assumed (the count byte may not be an entity count at all), or this client build cannot render a non-empty entity table from the wire
the hybrid body works precisely because count=0 skips the loop
next: verify the assumption that byte164 is a count: try a body where the table is present but the byte after it is something other than 1
or accept the limitation and move to match-flow work on the hybrid baseline
